吸收环节的药物相互作用案例分析（二）
任夏洋， 赵志刚\*首都医科大学附属北京天坛医院药剂科，北京 100050摘要：目的：说明药物在吸收阶段发生的相互作用。方法：分析文献和案例。结果：4例临床案例使用的药物因为在吸收阶段发生相互作用而增加或减少另一种药物的吸收，从而使血药浓度增高或降低。结论：两种药物在吸收阶段可以通过改变肠道菌群、胃肠动力及络合作用等机制而影响药物的吸收。
Cases about Drug Interaction in the Stage of Absorption(No.2)
REN Xia-yang, ZHAO Zhi-gang\*Department of Pharmacy, Beijing Tiantan Hospital Affiliated to Capital Medical University, Beijing 100050 Abstract: Objective: To study the mechanism of drug interaction in the stage of absorption. Methods: Based on literature and cases. Results: The blood concentration increased or decreased because of drug interaction on absorption in the four clinical cases. Conclusion: Two drugs can affected with each other on absorption by the change of intestinal bacteria, complexation and so on.两种或两种以上药物由于彼此（1）改变胃肠道酸碱度；（2）改变胃肠道运动机能；
